text: Ɓe ŋalɗi, ɓe wi'i: Kere ko an woni Yuusufa? Yuusufu maakani ɓe: Eyyo, ko min woni Yuusufa. Oo mo sutiɗon ɗoo takko am, ko neene-gooto am. Gomɗii Alla moƴƴorike e amen ɓoortugol e ko men naɓidi e mun, O ɓamta fii amen. Ko fii, kala hulirɗo Alla ɗoftagol yamirooje Makko ɗen, woɗɗitoo haɗaaɗi Makko ɗin, o muññii jarrabuyee, pellet, golle makko ɗen e moƴƴere jeyaa. Alla non yeebataa njoɓdi moƴƴinooɓe ɓen, ko O reenoowo ɓe ndi.
